text: Guildwood Community has a long and rich history starting with Rosa and Spencer Clark who created Canada’s first artists’ community, the Guild of All Arts. The couple welcomed artists of all backgrounds to their property and eager visitors came to see painters, sculptors, weavers and others in action. The site became so popular that the Clarks converted their home into the Guild Inn. In their later years, the Clarks sold their Guild property which now operates as the Guild Park and Gardens. This is the heart of Guildwood Village and contains many architectural artefacts which were saved during the 1960s when Toronto’s downtown was undergoing a major building boom. These treasures such as the Greek Theatre would have been lost forever had it not been for the preservationist mentality of the Clarks.
